title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1027 | 百年新企鹅、狮子宝宝、绿色星星
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🐧 科学家发现了一种新企鹅，它看起来和别的企鹅一模一样，但基因却讲了一个不同的故事，是 100 多年来第一种新企鹅！
🦁 苏格兰爱丁堡动物园迎来了 7 年来的第一对狮子宝宝，妈妈 Bindee 和宝宝们正在窝里安静休息！
⭐ 科学家发现了一颗可能看起来是绿色的星星，以前从来没有见过绿色的星星！

📖 Word of the day: waddle（摇摇摆摆地走）

🎮 小挑战：听完后像企鹅一样摇摇摆摆地穿过房间，并把今天的单词 waddle 教给一个人！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🐧 Scientists found a new penguin species that looks just like other gentoo penguins, but its genes tell a different story — the first new penguin species in more than one hundred years!
🦁 Edinburgh Zoo in Scotland welcomed its first lion cubs in seven years, and mom Bindee and the babies are resting quietly in their den!
⭐ Scientists found a star that could look green — no one had ever found a green star before!

📖 Word of the day: waddle

🎮 Tiny challenge: after listening, waddle across the room like a penguin and teach one person today's word, waddle!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. waddle（摇摇摆摆地走）
to walk with short steps, side to side, like a penguin
例：waddle like a penguin（像企鹅一样摇摇摆摆地走）

2. island（岛屿）
a piece of land with water all around it
例：a faraway island（遥远的岛屿）

3. roar（吼叫）
a loud, deep sound a lion makes
例：a lion roar（狮子的吼叫）

4. twinkle（闪烁）
to shine with small, quick flashes of light
例：stars twinkle in the sky（星星在天空中闪烁）
